title: §.IX: Dorsche's remaining canons — Philippica only private authority, not subsequent public; even publicly rejected
pass_a_gloss: Paragraph nine. Dorsche's remaining canons, by which he hints that the Philippica Confession was made by private authority alone, not also by subsequent public authority, and even that it was condemned and rejected by public authority,
pass_b_english: §. IX. Dorsche's remaining canons hint that the Philippica Confession rested on private authority alone — not on later public authority — and was even condemned and rejected by public authority.
source_text:
§. IX.
Dorschei Canones reliqui, quibus Confessionem Philippicam, privata tantum Auctoritate, non etiam publica Subsequente factam, quin, publicâ Auctoritate improbatam rejectamque, esse, innuit,
